decision_title: Transitional care and community bridging program
evidence_boundary: Synthetic portfolio evidence only. This is a CIHI-inspired decision-support model, not an official CIHI specification, submission, certification, or clinical recommendation.

approvals.evidence: No human approval is represented in this repository.
Required before go-live; deliberately not inferred from synthetic analytics.

measures.name: Cost per weighted case excluding ALC
measures.numerator: Total cost less ALC days multiplied by the modelled ALC per-diem
measures.exclusions: Suppressed or invalid abstracts blocked by the quality gate

measures.name: Stays with any ALC day
measures.numerator: Discharges with one or more ALC days
measures.exclusions: Invalid length-of-stay records blocked by the quality gate

measures.name: Risk-adjusted 30-day readmission O/E
measures.denominator: Expected readmissions after modelled case-mix adjustment
measures.exclusions: No external deaths or out-of-authority readmissions are modelled

measures.name: ALC bed equivalents
measures.denominator: 730 calendar days in the two-year evidence window

measures.name: Emergency department boarding hours
measures.semantic_anchor: Local operational measure; production definition required
measures.exclusions: Not present in the synthetic evidence model

measures.name: Surgical postponements for bed unavailability
measures.semantic_anchor: Local operational measure; production definition required
measures.numerator: Postponed procedures attributed to bed unavailability
measures.exclusions: Not present in the synthetic evidence model
